examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, 2 Samuel 20:14-15 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him, and they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
examples.english: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him, and they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

examples.text: Verzweifelt warfen sich Adam und Eva nieder und weinten. Sieben Tage weinten sie, ohne die Augen aufzuschlagen, ohne sich vom Boden zu erheben.
examples.translation: Desperately, Adam and Eve threw themselves to the ground and wept. They wept for seven days without opening their eyes, without getting up from the floor.
examples.english: Desperately, Adam and Eve threw themselves to the ground and wept. They wept for seven days without opening their eyes, without getting up from the floor.
